## GitHub trending to Discord

### How it works
For developer communities that want a short daily list of trending GitHub repositories in Discord. Every day at 13:00 the workflow calls the EveryInfra `github/trending` endpoint once, takes the top 5 repositories and posts them as one Discord embed with name, link, description and stars gained today.

If the call returns no repositories, nothing is sent that day. If a call fails, it is tried up to 3 times; then the run stops and shows the error in **Executions**.

### Setup
1. Get an EveryInfra API key at https://everyinfra.com/?utm_source=n8n-template
2. Create a **Header Auth** credential: Name `Authorization`, Value `Bearer YOUR_KEY`. Select it in **Get GitHub trending**.
3. In Discord: Channel settings > Integrations > Webhooks > New Webhook > Copy Webhook URL.
4. Paste the URL into `discord_webhook_url` in **Settings**.
5. Click **Execute workflow** to post today's list, then click **Publish**.

### Customization
Change the time in **Every day**. It uses the time zone in the workflow settings. Set `top_n` in **Settings** to show between 1 and 10 repositories. Cost: one call a day at $0.81 per 1,000 calls, about $0.02 a month. Calls that return no data are not charged. To post to Slack or another chat, change the message in **Build Discord message** and the URL in **Send to Discord**.

## When and what to send
Set the time in **Every day**. Set the webhook URL and how many repositories to show in **Settings**.

## Get today's list
One EveryInfra call per run. If it fails, it is tried up to 3 times.

## Build and send
Builds one Discord embed. If no repositories came back, nothing is sent.
